:::{#thm-ols-mean-cov}
#### Exact mean and covariance of $\evb$

Under the Gaussian linear regression model (@def-lm-general-form),
let $\mX$ be the $n \times (p+1)$ design matrix whose rows are $\tp{\vx_i}$,
and suppose $\mX$ has [full column rank](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-subspaces.html#def-full-column-rank).
Then, conditional on $\mX$,
the maximum likelihood estimator
$\evb = \inv{\tp{\mX}\mX}\tp{\mX}\vY$
is unbiased for $\vb$
and has covariance matrix $\ss \inv{\tp{\mX}\mX}$:

$$
\E{\evb \mid \mX} = \vb,
\qquad
\Cov{\evb \mid \mX} = \ss \underbrace{\inv{\tp{\mX}\mX}}_{(p+1) \times (p+1)}
$$ {#eq-ols-mean-cov}

These results are exact for every sample size,
not large-sample approximations.
:::
